info.name: Xerox Public Print EULA Sites API

description.content:
REST API for managing print jobs through the Xerox Public Print Service. Provides endpoints for job creation, status monitoring, site discovery, provider management, EULA handling, and print history management. All secure calls require xrxauth, user-email, and appid headers. If user-email is omitted the request is treated as an application request.
